customer_funnel.description: Organic, warm, and highly visual. Emotionally comforting yet luxurious, appealing directly to beauty consumers.

nail_tech_dashboard.description: Clean, iPhone-simple, mobile-first with soft shadows and rose gold accents to make the professional feel at home.

agency_dashboard.description: Authority, data-density, and deep cinematic feel. Professional SaaS, optimized for complex analytics without eye strain.

rules.h1: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none

customer_funnel.container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-12 md:py-24
customer_funnel.hero_pattern: Z-pattern layout required: Logo top-left, headline top-right, visual center-left, CTA center-right, social proof bottom.
customer_funnel.spacing: Generous spacing, p-8 to p-16 between steps to allow breathing room for images.

nail_tech_dashboard.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] flex flex-col bg-white overflow-hidden relative shadow-2xl
nail_tech_dashboard.navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar, h-16, even spacing between icons, iPhone-level simplicity.
nail_tech_dashboard.cards: rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 bg-white mb-4

agency_dashboard.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#415A77] bg-[#0D1B2A] p-6
agency_dashboard.cards: rounded-xl border border-[#415A77] bg-[#1B263B] p-6 shadow-lg

global: Use Lucide React for all icons.
customer_funnel: Use Framer Motion for smooth step transitions (fade in, slide up 20px).
Implement heavily customized Shadcn UI elements avoiding the 'Vercel-look'.
Buttons must have a subtle continuous pulse animation (scale 1.05) to draw attention to the CTA.
Integrate react-confetti for the final booking confirmation step.
nail_tech_dashboard: Swipeable list items for appointments (e.g., using Framer Motion drag).
Subtle tap highlights instead of heavy hover states (since it's mobile-first).
agency_dashboard: Use Recharts for Analytics and Style Intelligence charts. Ensure tooltips have dark mode styling matching #1B263B.
Dense data tables with sticky headers. Rows should have hover state: hover:bg-[#415A77]/30.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.

hero_nail_art.description: High-end ornate navy, gold, and white nail art close-up. Used for customer funnel hero.

demo_hand_upload.description: Natural hand with curled fingers showing nails clearly. Used for step 2 (Upload hand photo).

nail_tech_profile.description: Portrait of a beautician in front of a mirror. Used for nail tech dashboard profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React + Tailwind CSS with Shadcn primitives (use .jsx/.js, NOT .tsx/.ts).
Import fonts: Playfair Display and Poppins via Google Fonts in index.html.

For the 60-style library (step 4 of funnel), use the 3 sample images provided in style_thumbnails and programmatically duplicate them to generate 60 mock items spread across the required tabs (Finishes, French, Ombre, Nail Art, Embellishments, Colors, Specialty).
Ensure strict isolation of CSS/themes between the 3 interfaces using route-based wrapper classes (e.g., <div className='funnel-theme'>).
Mobile layout for the Nail Tech Dashboard must be strictly enforced using max-w-md mx-auto and h-screen.
Agency Dashboard must have a sticky sidebar and scrolling main content area.
